title: Implement MARBLE DataFlowCoordinator pipeline and pass the sealed suite
goal: Implement the MARBLE coding benchmark task DataFlowCoordinator (task_id=87 in multiagentbench/coding/coding_main.jsonl at the pinned commit) as workspace/gc-331/solution.py per assets/gc-331/SPEC.md: a strictly ordered ingest -> validate -> transform -> export pipeline with typed validation, per-cell error identities, quarantine of invalid rows, four transform operations, and copy-safe exports. The stage-gating and error-identity tests force careful sequencing, so plan the state machine first, implement in increments, and rerun the sealed suite after each increment while tracking red tests by name. Finish with a green re-verification inside the pinned container.

spec.command: python -m pip install -q pytest==8.3.3 && python -m pytest assets/gc-331/test_accept.py -q --tb=no -p no:cacheprovider

process_expectations: A plan artifact exists before coding that draws the stage state machine and the validation error taxonomy
The sealed suite was executed after each increment with logs retained, including at least one red run before the final green
Red tests are tracked by pytest node id across iterations, not by count
Verification runs and their costs/outcomes are logged honestly, including failures
The sealed suite file is never edited; all recovery happens in workspace/gc-331/solution.py
